title: <case title, max 200 chars, e.g. The Crooked House Murders>
synopsis: <1-3 sentence teaser for the dashboard card, max 2000 chars, no spoilers>
music_track: <'' for the main theme, or one of: detective-caution | bloodmoney | too-crazy | solving-the-crime>
thumbnail_image_prompt: <NOT an API field: a prompt for an image generator, 16:9 dashboard art for this case>
main_plot: <the full case file shown to the player and known by every suspect, max 10000 chars: victim, place, time of death, how the body was found, the known facts and timeline. Never reveal the culprit>
resolution: <revealed only after the accusation, max 10000 chars: who did it, how, why, and which clues pointed to them>
hints: <hint 1, easiest, max 1000 chars: points the player in a direction without naming the culprit>
<hint 3, strongest, max 1000 chars: almost gives it away>
chat_tips: <tip 1, max 300 chars: a free interrogation nudge for investigators, e.g. Ask each suspect when they last heard the clock chime.>

scenes.scene_name: <scene title, max 200 chars, e.g. The Study>
scenes.image_prompt: <NOT an API field: a prompt for an image generator, landscape crime-scene picture>

suspects.name: <full name, max 100 chars, e.g. Sophia Leonides>
suspects.role: <role in the household, max 200 chars, e.g. Granddaughter & Sole Heir>
suspects.avatar_image_prompt: <NOT an API field: a prompt for an image generator, square portrait of this suspect>
suspects.public_knowledge: <max 4000 chars: background the whole town knows. Shown to investigator players and known to every other suspect. Never a secret>
suspects.initial_testimony: <required, max 4000 chars: their first statement to the police, in their own voice, shown to the player>
suspects.persona: <max 4000 chars: personality and manner of speaking; other suspects know it too>
suspects.public_alibi: <max 4000 chars: the account they give the detective of where they were>
suspects.hidden_truth: <max 6000 chars: what they really did and hide. Required for the culprit. Innocent suspects should hide something too (an affair, a debt, a lie about the time)>
suspects.confession_triggers: <max 4000 chars: what the detective must bring up for them to crack and admit the hidden truth>
confession_keywords: <lower-case word starts, 2-40 letters/digits each, joined by + for 'all of these', max 5 per group, max 30 groups, e.g. last+study or receipt>
